_about: Public-domain Patrick Fairbairn (1805-1874, Free Church of Scotland, principal of the Free Church College, Glasgow) for the Word Hoard: his own books (1849-1876): The Typology of Scripture (4th ed., 1864, 2 vols), Jonah, the Hermeneutical Manual, Prophecy, The Revelation of Law in Scripture, the Pastoral Epistles, Pastoral Theology and Ezekiel, raw Internet Archive OCR. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of it. His translations of German commentators (Hengstenberg, Dorner, Lisco, Steiger) are other men's books and stay off. Added 2026-10-02 by lane A, round 6 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
